name: Async tasks & await stacks
description: Two independent managed tasks suspend and resume. Pause to inspect Threads and Parallel Stacks; these are cooperative contexts, not OS threads.

name: Cooperative thread stacks
description: Thread.Start/Join, logical thread names, shared managed statics, freeze/thaw and independent stacks.

name: Live method-body changes
description: F5 pauses before Calculate. Open Hot Reload, Edit code, change x + 1 to x + 10, Apply & Continue. Managed state is retained.

name: Set Next Statement
description: F5 stops at value = 2. Right-click the final WriteLine and choose Set Next Statement. Skipped assignments are not executed; live values remain unchanged.

name: Explicit managed function evaluation
description: Pause, open Immediate, explicitly enable side effects, then evaluate ledger.Add(2), ledger.Doubled, or new Ledger(10).Add(1). Try rollback mode.

name: Portable PDB source and locals
description: Build exports matching embedded/sidecar symbols. Inspect Symbols, or load the DLL in Assembly Explorer and debug verified source independently of the workspace.

name: WinUI counter · code first
description: Real C# creates HTML controls using the supported WinUI API. Click Increment; Hot Reload can replace the handler without restarting the window.

name: WinUI form · input and selection
description: TextBox, Slider, ComboBox, ToggleSwitch, CheckBox, ProgressBar and Expander use native HTML input. Submit reads the actual managed input state.

name: WinUI graphics · WebGPU / Canvas / DOM
description: Retained Canvas shapes and an explicit DrawingSurface extension. Choose a renderer in the WinUI tool. HTML text and input stay accessible.

name: WinUI async callback · debugger
description: Click Calculate. The C# handler changes UI, awaits a real timer, then updates the same controls. Set a breakpoint after await and inspect its logical stack.
